resources.string: Jarvis screen guard: keeps Jarvis on a child\'s tablet (removing it needs a parent\'s login) and follows the screen-time rules their parents set, such as bedtime and school hours. Calls, texts and Jarvis always work.

Jarvis OS reads from Health Connect only what you allow: sleep sessions, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, weight, and walks, runs and rides (with their distance).

It only reads; it never writes to Health Connect. Steps are not read, because Jarvis already counts them on this tablet.

What it reads goes to your own household Jarvis server and nowhere else: sleep and measurements to your Health page, workouts to Fitness. Each reading keeps the label health_connect so you can tell it from what you logged by hand. Your family sees it only if you share that part of Health with them.

To stop, open Jarvis → Health → Health → Health Connect → Disconnect, or remove Jarvis's access in Health Connect. Readings already imported stay on your server until you delete them there.
